title: 教学知识与临床病例：数据类型如何塑造医疗大语言模型
summary: 研究通过token匹配实验探究教学数据与临床数据比例对医疗大模型的影响，发现存在非对称迁移：临床数据提升临床任务且知识任务仍有竞争力，教学数据主要提升知识任务；错误分析揭示"知-行差距"，少量临床数据即可带来大部分电子病历任务收益，数据配比应依应用场景而定。
summary_en: This study uses token-matched experiments to examine how didactic-to-clinical data ratios shape medical LLMs, revealing asymmetric transfer: clinical data improves clinic-oriented tasks while staying competitive on knowledge tasks, whereas didactic data mainly boosts knowledge tasks. Error analysis suggests a knowing-doing gap, and modest clinical data yields most EHR-task gains, implying application-driven data curation.
